version.commandsIntro: From a copy of the repository, with Python (through uv) and Node 24. The first two commands check the published web data against the pipeline outputs; rebuilding those outputs from the raw sources starts with the pipeline's fetch and build commands, described in the repository.
version.commands:
uv sync --locked
uv run python -m pipeline export --check   # rebuild the web data and compare byte for byte
uv run python -m pipeline test           # every offline test, including the web unit tests (needs Node 24)
npm --prefix web ci
npm --prefix web run test:web            # build the site and run the browser tests
